log.description: Implemented action recording: recordingStore Map, ActionEntry interface, POST /v1/recording/start + stop + GET /v1/recording, recordAction helper with timing. Navigate and click record actions with durationMs. 29 endpoints total.

20 tests for action recording: start (response/sessionId/requires session), stop (response/actions count/requires session), get (status/array/requires session), ActionEntry shape (action/params/timestamp/durationMs), recordAction behavior (inactive/active/navigate/click), lifecycle (create/delete/empty). 357 total.

feat-action-recording: correct store lifecycle, recordAction guard (no-op when inactive), timing with Date.now delta, stop returns count before delete, get distinguishes active-empty from inactive. 20 tests. Approved.

Improved withBrowser: clear error message on connection failure ('session may have crashed'), try/catch on disconnect (ignore if already dead). Prevents cryptic WebSocket errors from reaching clients.

Updated integration tests: endpoint count 25->29 (added recording 3 + metrics), session-required 19->22 (added recording), dependency graph expanded to 9 modules (added fingerprint/webhooks/rate-limiter/client). 357 total.
Validated userDataDir on session creation: rejects path traversal (..) and control characters (\r\n\0). Prevents Chrome writing data to sensitive system directories via malicious userDataDir param.
Cleaned up package.json: removed unused fastify dependency, added 'start' script (node dist/api.js). Reduces install size and provides standard production start command.
Added ANVIL_HOST env var (default 0.0.0.0) for bind address control. Operators can set to 127.0.0.1 for local-only access. Startup log shows actual bind address. 8 env vars total.
Added SIGKILL fallback in killBrowser: if Chrome doesn't exit within 3s of SIGTERM, force-kills with SIGKILL. Prevents zombie Chrome processes on Windows/hung Chrome.
Designed GET /v1/docs: self-documenting endpoint listing with method/path/description/params for all 29 endpoints, grouped by category, exempt from auth+rate-limit, includes version.

Implemented GET /v1/docs: static JSON response with all 30 endpoints documented, grouped by 7 categories (sessions/actions/content/network/recording/files/observability), exempt from auth+rate-limit. 30 endpoints total.
Wrapped URL parsing in try/catch at request entry. Malformed URLs (null bytes, invalid encoding) now return 400 'Malformed URL' instead of crashing the handler with unhandled exception.
Added uncaughtException and unhandledRejection handlers. Logs to stderr instead of crashing the server process. Prevents total service outage from unexpected errors in async code paths.
Updated total endpoint count from 29 to 30 (added GET /v1/docs). Integration test now verifies complete 30-endpoint surface area.

Blocked dangerous URL protocols in navigate/scrape/pdf endpoints. Rejects file://, javascript:, data: URLs with 400. Prevents local file read (file://), XSS (javascript:), and data exfiltration via Chrome.

Updated Dockerfile: added ANVIL_ENGINE_PORT and ANVIL_HOST env defaults, added Docker HEALTHCHECK (30s interval, hits /v1/health). Container now self-reports health to orchestrators (ECS, K8s, Docker Compose).
Added null guard in scrape text extraction: document.body?.innerText || ''. Prevents crash on bodyless pages (XML, about:blank, error pages).
Added ANVIL_MAX_SESSIONS env (default 10) with 503 rejection when limit reached. Prevents memory exhaustion from unbounded session creation. 9 env vars total.
Added 5 missing SDK client methods: startRecording, stopRecording, getRecording, metrics, docs. Client now covers all 30 endpoints. 30 typed methods total.

Added authentication to CDP WebSocket proxy. When ANVIL_API_KEY is set, WebSocket connections must include ?token=<key> query param or get closed with 4001. Previously anyone with a session ID could bypass REST API auth entirely via ws://.
Updated client test method count from 25 to 30 (added startRecording/stopRecording/getRecording/metrics/docs). Test now verifies full SDK coverage.
